business: Moos Matcha Bar (an example: a walk-in matcha café in Berlin)
target: Young professionals and students, 22 to 38, in Berlin Mitte and Prenzlauer Berg, who buy a coffee or tea out most days

behaviours.name: Daily regular
behaviours.how: Buys the same drink at the same place most mornings.

behaviours.name: Health-first
behaviours.how: Reads ingredients, prefers bio and plant-based, swaps coffee for anything that feels cleaner.

behaviours.name: Trend chaser
behaviours.how: Tries whatever is new and posts it on Instagram.

behaviours.name: Preis-Leistung
behaviours.how: Compares prices, thinks a drink should be worth what it costs, brings a Thermos from home most days.

behaviours.name: Sustainability-minded
behaviours.how: Brings a reusable cup, cares about single-use plastic, organic and where the matcha comes from.

behaviours.name: Loyal to their Späti or café
behaviours.how: Has a favourite spot round the corner where the staff know them.

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Checks Google Maps ratings before trying anywhere new.

objections: 5,90 € is a lot for a drink
Does matcha actually taste good, or is it just Instagram?
Is it really healthier than coffee?
I need somewhere to sit and work with my laptop
Do they take card, or cash only?
I'd try it once, not every day
habits: you cycle past Rosenthaler Platz on the way to work
you work from home three days a week
you meet friends for brunch on Sundays
you study at a library near the U8
